dialogue.speech: The one who was in the pillar's shadow...

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: was me!

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: Wh-What...

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: What's going o—

dialogue.name: Boss
dialogue.speech: I decided to show you... as a parting gift.

dialogue.name: Boss
dialogue.speech: Since this is the end, I'll fill you in.

dialogue.name: Boss
dialogue.speech: What you just witnessed and felt

dialogue.name: Boss
dialogue.speech: was you in the future.

dialogue.name: Boss
dialogue.speech: You from a few seconds from the past witnessed yourself in the future.

dialogue.name: Boss
dialogue.speech: This is my Emperor Crimson's ability.

dialogue.name: Boss
dialogue.speech: I erased time and leapt past it.

dialogue.name: Boss
dialogue.speech: I don't care who it is.

dialogue.name: JoJo-main
dialogue.speech: I will not allow anyone to threaten my throne,

dialogue.name: Boss
dialogue.speech: no matter what.

dialogue.name: Boss
dialogue.speech: And now, you're going to have to disappear.

dialogue.name: Boss
dialogue.speech: Bucciarati, your mission to act as Trish's bodyguard

dialogue.name: Boss
dialogue.speech: has now come to an end.
